title: 第23章 流民暴乱第24章 侍女危机
slug: 绑定全国每人每天给我一两银
lines: 翌日，天光微亮。
陆舟已经醒来。
【当前云州常住人口数：87万4千4百11人！】
【今日收益：87万4千4百57两白银！】
【累计余额：524万6千1百32两白银！】
他看着系统面板，面色凝重。
眼下，他距离突破至六品顶级武者，只剩下不到四十万两白银了。
过了今日，自己就有实力与刘傲硬刚了！
想到昨夜以及先前的各种羞辱，陆舟眸中的杀意就已经有些抑制不住了。
有些仇，总算是可以报了！
外面。
周川也早早醒来，正一脸愁容地看着面前的粮食。
虽说早上的吃食不必太多，但这有上百号百姓，这点粮食，根本不够他们吃的。
他揉了揉太阳穴，看出了这背后是刘傲在报复。
“大人，要不要跟王爷说？”身旁，一名下属低声询问。
这种时候，也只有王爷能够解决了。
“暂时不要这样做。”周川摇头。
昨夜之事，已让王爷失去了不少威望。
若此事能解决还好，若不能解决，反倒会再次打击百姓对其信任度。
眼下距离云城，只剩三四天时间了。
能不出乱子，就尽量不要出乱子。
想到这，他看向属下：“先把我们自己的粮食拿出来。”
此前在茶城时，陆舟为了改善伙食，私下又购置了一批粮食。
这批粮食，哪怕是刘傲都没有资格处置。
属下领命离去。
周川站在原地，看着不远处的流民，微微叹气。
他们的粮食省着点用，是能够撑到云城的，只希望不要再出变故。
车队继续南行。
陆舟端坐马车，闭目养神。
他脑中正思索着等明日提升至六品顶级后，该如何解决刘傲更好。
毕竟对方是陆哲的心腹，还是神武军中的小统领。
除却其本身实力之外，身上或许还有底牌。
“不能硬碰硬！”他暗自思索。
自己的目的不仅仅是杀刘傲，还得稳住这六十多名甲士，避免人员损伤。
若那刘傲临死反扑，容易得不偿失。
想到这，陆舟下意识摩挲了一下食指的黑色戒指。
content_en:
The next day, the sky was slightly bright.
Lu Zhou has woken up.
[The current permanent population of Yunzhou: 874,411 people! 】
[Today’s income: 874,457 taels of silver! 】
[Cumulative balance: 5,246,132 taels of silver! 】
He looked at the system panel with a solemn expression.
Right now, he only has less than 400,000 taels of silver left before he can break through to the top level six warriors.
After today, I will have the strength to fight Liu Ao!
Thinking of last night and all the previous humiliations, the killing intent in Lu Zhou's eyes became somewhat uncontrollable.
Some revenge can finally be avenged!
Outside.
Zhou Chuan also woke up early and was looking at the food in front of him with a sad expression.
Although there is not much food to eat in the morning, there are hundreds of people, and this little food is not enough for them.
He rubbed his temples and saw that Liu Ao was seeking revenge behind this.
"Sir, do you want to tell the prince?" Beside him, a subordinate asked in a low voice.
At this time, only the prince can solve the problem.
"Don't do this for now." Zhou Chuan shook his head.
What happened last night has caused the prince to lose a lot of prestige.
It would be great if this matter can be resolved, but if it cannot be resolved, it will once again undermine people's trust in it.
There are only three or four days left before we reach Yuncheng.
If you can avoid making trouble, try not to make trouble.
Thinking of this, he looked at his subordinates: "Take out our own food first."
When he was in the tea city before, Lu Zhou privately purchased another batch of grain in order to improve his food supply.
Not even Liu Ao is qualified to handle this batch of grain.
The subordinates were ordered to leave.
Zhou Chuan stood there, looking at the refugees not far away, and sighed slightly.
If they save some food, they can make it to Yuncheng. They just hope there won't be another accident.
…
The convoy continued southbound.
Lu Zhou sat in the carriage and closed his eyes to rest.
He was thinking about how to better deal with Liu Ao after he was promoted to the top level of the sixth level tomorrow.
After all, the other party was Lu Zhe's confidant and the junior commander of the Shenwu Army.
In addition to its own strength, it may also have a trump card.
"We can't fight head-on!" he thought to himself.
His goal was not only to kill Liu Ao, but also to stabilize the more than sixty soldiers to avoid personal injury.
If Liu Ao were to fight back before his death, it would be easy for him to lose more than he gained.
Thinking of this, Lu Zhou subconsciously rubbed the black ring on his index finger.
